Jatamansi Powder Exporter: Spikenard Root Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Jatamansi powder is the fine milled root and rhizome of Nardostachys jatamansi, also known as Indian spikenard. Tradenest Naturals is a jatamansi powder exporter for herbal, cosmetic and supplement brands in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe. Buyers who need a dependable spikenard powder supplier come to us for steady quality and clear paperwork. Every batch is processed with the same care, so results stay consistent from order to order. Many buyers look to buy jatamansi powder online bulk without the risk of an unknown supplier. They need a partner who answers questions and ships on schedule. We handle cleaning, drying, milling and packing ourselves, which keeps quality in our own hands. Our milling and sieving equipment produces an even powder that keeps the root's natural earthy aroma.

Why Choose Our Bulk Jatamansi Powder?

In the herbal and botanical trade, small differences between lots cause big problems for formulators. That is why we hold ourselves to clear standards as a pure jatamansi powder manufacturer. Raw roots are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers and collectors. We clean and inspect the material before it goes to the mill. Nothing is added during processing, so you receive a single-ingredient root powder. Understanding the jatamansi root powder price is important for your budget. We quote fair, transparent prices and flexible terms for larger orders. Our minimum order is only 5 Kg, so you can trial the material before you scale. With a steady supply of natural jatamansi powder bulk, your production can run without unwanted gaps.

Processing and Quality Control

At Tradenest Naturals, we combine traditional handling with modern equipment. First, we select mature roots from reliable sources. Next, the roots are dried and fine milled under controlled conditions. This helps prevent moisture build-up and spoilage, and moisture is kept at or below 8%. We follow written handling procedures at each step. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Each shipment also comes with export documentation support. As a result, importing from us is a smooth process for your team.

Key Specifications and Applications

Our fine milled powder blends easily into a wide range of formulations. It is sieved to 80-100 mesh for even mixing. It has a distinct earthy, woody aroma and a bitter taste. These traits suit herbal supplements, cosmetics and traditional formulations. Many cosmetic brands use jatamansi in herbal hair oils and aromatic products. Supplement brands fill it into capsules for traditional Ayurvedic formulations. Because it is so versatile, it serves several markets. OEM and private label packing is available as well.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Ordering

We pack in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. Stored cool and dry, the shelf life is 24 months. You can choose from stand-up pouches, HDPE containers or bulk bags. We also offer private label packing for retail brands. What is the minimum order quantity for jatamansi powder exporter orders? Our MOQ is 5 Kg, and we quote freight for bulk orders on request. How do I request a sample? Samples are available on request. Reach out to our sales team today for a quote or a sample.
